messages.content: You are maintaining an inference optimization campaign. Keep answers concise, technical, and reproducible.

Campaign facts: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B uses hybrid attention and MoE layers. The Intel i5-1340P exposes AVX2 and AVX-VNNI; Iris Xe exposes FP16 and integer dot product but no cooperative matrices. CPU generation is currently faster than full Vulkan. Native MTP draft-1 has high acceptance and improves CPU generation. Vulkan multi-column Q2_K decode gains at N=2 but plateaus at N=4. Disabling MMVQ or integer dot product removes the gain. A same-session CPU/Vulkan branch-overlap prototype was correct but regressed because both devices streamed weights through shared LPDDR. The next work targets a model-specific exact-row Vulkan kernel and reduced MTP orchestration overhead. State the three invariants that all promoted changes must preserve.

The change must preserve deterministic target logits and token acceptance, maintain correct KV and recurrent rollback state across partial MTP acceptance, and retain the generic Vulkan path as a safe fallback for unsupported shapes or devices.
Now turn those invariants into a compact release gate with measurable thresholds for correctness, performance, stability, and fallback coverage.
